## Artifact or command

Identify the script, executable, certificate, digest, or documented command.

## Environment

Operating system, architecture, language/tool versions, commit SHA, and relevant hardware limits.

## Expected result

State the documented expected output and finite range.

## Actual result

Include complete output, error text, mismatched digest, or smallest differing input.

## Reproduction steps

Provide the shortest deterministic reproduction you can.

## Independence

State whether your implementation imports or shares code with the primary implementation.
